def validate_session(self, client, session):
        """Validate this session before use with client.

        Raises error if this session is logged in as a different user or
        the client is not the one that created the session.
        """
        if session.client is not client:
            raise PermissionError(
                f"Session {session.name} created by {session.client.name} is not "
                f"associated with {client.name}.")
        if session.user is not None and session.user != client.user:
            raise PermissionError(
                f"Session {session.name} is logged in as user {session.user.username}.")
